For the required counts \(1\) green-red, \(2\) green-blue, \(3\) red-blue:

Choose balls for each pair type:
\[
\binom{3}{1}\binom{4}{1}\binom{2}{2}\binom{5}{2}\binom{3}{3}\binom{3}{3}
\]
Then pair selected balls within each type:
\[
1!\cdot 2!\cdot 3!
\]
Thus the total is
\[
\binom{3}{1}\binom{4}{1}\binom{2}{2}\binom{5}{2}\binom{3}{3}\binom{3}{3}\cdot 1!\cdot 2!\cdot 3!
= 3\cdot 4\cdot 1\cdot 10\cdot 1\cdot 1\cdot 1\cdot 2\cdot 6
= 1440.
\]
\[
\boxed{1440}
\]
